backend/main.mo: Motoko canister handling user profiles, onboarding with 10 PKR funding, balance queries, and admin-controlled fund distribution with AccessControl checks.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence listing onboarding-related frontend changes, affected files, components, and associated requirement IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing short descriptions of key frontend files including pages, components, hooks, and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base theme definitions and dark mode color variables for global styling.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router with routes for main pages including profile and admin sections.
frontend/src/components/AppFooter.tsx: Footer with referral link display, copy-to-clipboard functionality, and credits link.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Header with logo, profile button, and dynamic height measurement to position UI elements.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Root layout with background, balance indicator, onboarding auto-run after login, and toast-based error handling.
frontend/src/components/BalanceIndicator: Displays the user’s balance, admin wallet balance for admins, and prompts for sign‑in or zero‑balance help based on authentication state.
frontend/src/components/OrderConfirmatio: Shows order confirmation details including order ID, selected package info, video URL, and next steps with navigation buttons.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user’s identity and refreshes dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUrl.ts: Returns the current browser URL once on mount.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, handling login, stored identities, and status management.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, balances, admin status, and fund distribution via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind base styles, theming variables, dark mode values, and utility classes for safe fixed positioning.
frontend/src/lib/backendError.ts: Converts backend error messages into standardized, user-friendly strings.
frontend/src/lib/copyToClipboard.ts: Implements clipboard copying using the Clipboard API with a fallback for unsupported environments.
frontend/src/lib/format.ts: Utility functions for formatting timestamps, IDs, PKR amounts, and bigint balances.
frontend/src/lib/packages.ts: Defines the Package interface and a list of preset TikTok booster packages with prices and benefits.
frontend/src/lib/validation.ts: Provides URL validation logic returning a structured ValidationResult.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point initializing React, Internet Identity, and React Query providers.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard showing wallet balance and system info with error and loading states.
frontend/src/pages/CreditsPage.tsx: Displays project credits, features, and contact information for TikTok Booster Pro.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Admin panel for placing mock TikTok orders and distributing funds with balance checks and local order tracking.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Home page allowing users to select booster packages and submit TikTok video URLs with validation and UI feedback.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: User profile page supporting viewing, editing, and saving profile data with image upload and logout functionality.
frontend/src/pages/StatusPage.tsx: React page showing order status placeholder with contact info and navigation back home.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters using query strings, hash routing, and sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS config defining theme extensions, colors, animations, plugins, and container settings.
project_state.json: Metadata describing current project state, architecture notes, known issues, and feature history.
